queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
s AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share
  FROM c
)
SELECT timespan, cnt AS risk_margin_count, share,
       share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS deviation_from_avg_share
FROM s;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT timespan, cnt AS risk_margin_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS deviation
FROM shares;
WITH tifs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT timespan FROM orders
),
counts AS (
  SELECT t.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) AS cnt
  FROM tifs t
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.timespan = t.timespan
  LEFT JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY t.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT timespan,
       cnt AS risk_margin_count,
       share AS share_of_total,
       share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS deviation_from_avg_share
FROM shares;
